reference.source: manuscript text (exact) unless a block states otherwise; null = not reported
reference.estimand: The manuscript's Evaluation protocol states that each reported point estimate is the metric computed on the pooled out-of-fold scores, and that the reported 95% confidence interval is the Student t interval across the five folds.

fig4_read_auroc.note: Bar heights read from manuscript Fig. 5 (leg crop, pass-level AUROC on the pooled out-of-fold scores, per the Evaluation protocol); about +/-0.01. Fig. 5 in the current numbering, in which the pipeline block diagram is Figure 1; this bar chart was Fig. 4 before that figure was inserted.

patchcore_cgi.ci_basis: Student t interval across the five folds
patchcore_cgi.pooled_auroc_note: The 0.668 headline AUROC, which the Evaluation protocol identifies as the pooled out-of-fold value; same number as main_auroc.patchcore.CGI.

reference.fusion_auroc_approx_note: The design-factor analysis states the about-0.58 late-fusion AUROC for the Subspace detector; no PatchCore late-fusion value is reported.
reference.fusion_single_best_exact_note: The manuscript's own comparison value for the about-0.58 fusion result: Subspace CGI, leg crop; same number as main_auroc.subspace.CGI.
reference.approximate_values_source: manuscript text (stated as approximate): hei_band, fusion_auroc_approx, fusion_single_best_approx, percow_auroc_approx
